title: LIVE ICE THICKNESS
noaa_source: U.S. National Ice Center (NAIS) daily Great Lakes ice analysis, SIGRID-3 shapefile
product_name: U.S. National Ice Center (NAIS) daily Great Lakes ice analysis, SIGRID-3 shapefile
variable: ice thickness derived from WMO stage-of-development (SA/SB/SC) range midpoints, concentration-weighted
data_time_utc: NIC analysis date 2026-05-16 (from NIC filename; retrieved 2026-09-22 00:35 UTC)
units: in (display); derived from WMO stage ranges in cm
spatial_resolution_source: NIC SIGRID-3 vector analysis (variable polygon size)
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: open water (CT<1) and stages without an authoritative thickness (brash/unstaged/old/glacier/unknown) rendered fully transparent; NEVER zero-filled or guessed.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.
attribution: Data: US NOAA. This project is not endorsed by NOAA. See DATA_SOURCES.md for exact products and endpoints.
legend_scale_html: Ice thickness (inches, WMO stage-derived estimates): thinner 0 in (light blue) → blue → deep blue → thicker 12 in (purple). No color is painted where there is no ice; fainter = partial concentration.
data_nature: derived/estimated from analyzed ice stages; NOT a direct measurement
methodology: Per SIGRID-3 polygon: thickness = sum(partial_conc_i * WMO_stage_midpoint_i) / sum(partial_conc_i) over SA/SB/SC stages with authoritative ranges (see nic_sigrid.STAGE_TABLE); cm/2.54 -> inches; pixel alpha scaled by total concentration CT/10. Off-season ice-free analyses are valid-empty.
